title: Income Annuities Commutation: The Installment Falling Due Near the Election Day
content:
When a beneficiary of an Ashgrove Income Annuities period-certain contract elects the commuted value, the installment whose payment date is close to the election day is treated as follows (the cutoff is **10** calendar days, counted from the election day to the contract's next payment date):

- **Next payment date after the election day but within 10 days of it** (1 to 10 days after): that installment is left out of the commuted count and paid on its own schedule.
- **Election on a payment date** (the next payment date is the election day itself): the installment due that day is left out of the count and paid undiscounted with the commuted value, at the current installment on the contract.
- Where the next payment date is neither the election day nor within 10 days after it, neither of these treatments applies.

| Days from the election day to the next payment date | Installment due on that date |
|---|---|
| 0 (election on the payment date) | Left out of the count; paid undiscounted with the commuted value |
| 1 to 10 | Left out of the count; paid on its own schedule |
| 11 or more | Neither treatment applies |

**Edges (hypothetical, next payment date 1 June).** Election on 1 June: the 1 June installment is paid with the commuted value, undiscounted. Election on 22 May (10 days before): the 1 June installment is paid on 1 June on its own schedule and is not commuted. Election on 21 May (11 days before): neither treatment applies.
